verses.text: <pb/><e>Abù Ọma Devid, mb͕e o siri n'iru Absalom nwa-ya b͕alaga.</e> <pb/><t>Jehova, le otú ndi nākpab͕um bara uba!</t> <t>Ọtutu madu nēbili imegidem.</t>
<t>Ọtutu madu nēkwu okwu bayere nkpuru-obim, si,</t> <t>Ọ dighi nzọputa diri ya nime Chineke.</t>
<t>Ma Gi onwe-gi, Jehova, bu ọta buruburum,</t> <t>Na nsọpurum, na onye nēbuli isim elu.</t>
<t>Ejim olum kpọkue Jehova,</t> <t>O we zam site n'ugwu nsọ Ya.</t>
<t>Mu onwem dinara ala, raru ura;</t> <t>Etetaram; n'ihi na Jehova nākwagidem.</t>
<t>M'gaghi-atu egwu ìgwè ndi nkem anāpughi iguta aguta,</t> <t>Ndi doworo onwe-ha imegidem buruburu.</t>
<t>Bilie, Jehova; zọputam, Chinekem:</t> <t>N'ihi na I tiwo ndi-irom nile ihe na ǹtì;</t> <t>I tipiawo ezé ndi nēmebi iwu.</t>
